channel.title: LoLaBo — Lorapok Labs Blog
channel.description: Notes on public Lorapok repositories by Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder.

item.title: Lorapok Inventory System keeps each shop in its own database
item.description: The Lorapok-Inventory-System README describes a multi-tenant point of sale where each shop has its own subdomain, branding, and database.

item.title: MindNode encrypts notes in the browser before they are stored
item.description: The MindNode README describes a key-based notepad that encrypts notes with the Web Crypto API and does not keep server-side keys.

item.title: Lorapok Atlas is a dashboard for browsing public APIs
item.description: The Atlas README describes a directory where developers browse and live-test public APIs. The same repository is published under both @Maijied and @Lorapok.

item.title: Cursor Curse Monitor reads Cursor usage on the local machine
item.description: The extension README describes a dashboard for Cursor limits, remaining quota, billing-cycle reset, and on-demand spend.

item.title: Loragent is a multi-agent catalog with 224 skill definitions on this site
item.description: The Loragent README describes an orchestration framework for IDE agents. The skill index in this repository counts 224 definitions.

item.title: SeeYou audits a site the way a crawler renders it
item.description: The SeeYou README describes an agentic SEO tool with a remote MCP server, a hosted API, and a dashboard.

item.title: FreqGhost visualizes WiFi sensing and vital signs
item.description: The FreqGhost README describes a WiFi sensing observatory that maps motion and estimates respiration and heart rate from channel state information.

item.title: ReportKit is a PHP report stack for Laravel and plain PHP
item.description: The ReportKit README describes a prepare, store, compose, and send flow that targets current Laravel and older plain-PHP deployments.

item.title: Roast as a Service is a static JSON API of developer roasts
item.description: The roast-as-a-service README describes a static API on GitHub Pages that returns developer roasts for apps, bots, terminals, or CI logs.

item.title: dCursor runs a second Cursor instance beside the first
item.description: The dCursor README describes a Debian package that mirrors Cursor with a separate account, extensions, agent, MCP servers, and settings.
